# Meshtastic workspace instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` for workspace ownership, Git submodule workflow, and user authorization rules. Read `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` before tracker operations. All project issues and specifications belong to `the-Drunken-coder/meshtastic-workspace`.

Read the component's own instructions before changing files. Firmware's canonical instructions are `firmware/.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
